opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (special cases up to £750,000, most below £300,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations; applicants must be employed by the host institution for the project duration; excludes individuals without formal employment, schools, colleges, undergraduates, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, local charities, and organisations not based in the UK (except exceptional overseas cases).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the five priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review, aiming to improve lives in the UK.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, especially racially minoritised communities; encourages partnerships between researchers and racially minoritised communities; UK-based institutions primarily, with focus on research that informs racial justice and inclusion.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, identities, aspirations, civic participation, and life chances, to inform an inclusive society.
